title: Wire live market data dual-write sink
description: Enable live Nautilus market-data publication to persist QuoteTick rows to both ParquetDataCatalog and ClickHouse through a repo-level persistence hook, then roll the Alpaca containers and validate both sinks receive data.
notes:
Paused per user request. Implemented generic live QuoteTick dual-write worker and compose/env wiring; host cargo checks passed for nautilus-persistence clickhouse, nautilus-data warehouse-clickhouse, and nautilus-alpaca live,warehouse-clickhouse. Docker release build did not publish a new image before pause; nautilus-alpaca:local is still the 2026-06-22 image. Services shut down: deploy/alpaca engine/postgres removed, deploy/warehouse ClickHouse removed; volumes preserved. Next step: rebuild Docker image to completion, run docker compose with --env-file .env, start warehouse/migrate, run bounded alpaca-option-chain-live smoke, then verify /state/catalog files and market.quote_ticks source=alpaca-live rows.
Resume note: work stopped after implementing but before live rollout proof. Current worktree contains uncommitted dual-write changes: new crates/persistence/src/warehouse/live.rs, persistence warehouse mod export, nautilus-data warehouse-clickhouse feature and DataEngine hook, nautilus-live/alpaca feature propagation, Docker/install feature updates, Alpaca/warehouse Compose env wiring, and .beads update. Local .env has NAUTILUS_MARKET_DATA_DUAL_WRITE=true, ClickHouse URL host.docker.internal:8123, bridge bind CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_HOST=172.17.0.1, and a bounded SPY 2026-06-26 live-node smoke config. Host verification passed: cargo fmt, cargo check -p nautilus-persistence --features clickhouse --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-data --features warehouse-clickhouse --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live,warehouse-clickhouse --bins. Docker image build was interrupted/did not publish; nautilus-alpaca:local still inspected as old image sha256:73495714... created 2026-06-22T15:43:34-05:00. Services were intentionally shut down per user: no nautilus-alpaca or nautilus-warehouse containers remain running; volumes preserved. Next pickup: finish docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/alpaca/compose.yml --profile engine build alpaca-options, start ClickHouse with bridge HTTP bind, run warehouse migrate/health via cargo run -p nautilus-cli, recreate Alpaca engine/live node with --env-file .env, run bounded alpaca-option-chain-live smoke, then verify catalog files under /state/catalog and ClickHouse market.quote_ticks rows for source=alpaca-live.
2026-06-25 sizing pause: user flagged ClickHouse memory risk before restarting services. No ClickHouse/Alpaca warehouse services were booted. Rough local state: host has 28GiB RAM and ~20GiB available; current ClickHouse compose default is mem_limit=4g/cpus=2; existing preserved Nautilus warehouse volumes already show ~854MB data and ~927MB logs before real live ingestion. Current bounded smoke config is tiny (~138 quote rows: SPY, one expiry, 3 strikes x calls/puts, 2s polling, 45s max runtime), but broad actor defaults can be ~196k rows/day per option series at 42 contracts/5s over 6.5h, ~4.3M rows/day for 22 underlyings x one expiry, and materially higher for multiple expiries or 2s polling. Before rollout, choose validation caps/retention/log limits instead of running ClickHouse as an unbounded quote sink.
2026-06-25 live rollout validation complete. Rebuilt nautilus-alpaca:local with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1; image id sha256:6d3ffe11c4e15f70d13857d76af1abeb1769905f4101044b645d6a38d4999b57 created 2026-06-25T07:08:55-05:00. Recreated alpaca-options from the fresh image. ClickHouse ran self-hosted with CLICKHOUSE_MEM_LIMIT=2g and CLICKHOUSE_CPUS=1; observed memory stayed roughly 1.15-1.34GiB during build and smoke. libpostal-api restart_count stayed 4 and oom=false throughout capped build/smoke. Fresh default compose live node ran 45s for SPY 2026-06-26, ATM-relative 1 strike above/below, no fixed-strike override; dual-write worker started source=alpaca-live ingest_run_id=195375e4-57f9-43f1-a537-debfd1ba6c43. Catalog wrote six per-instrument QuoteTick parquet files under /state/catalog/data/quotes for SPY260626 C/P 737/738/739. ClickHouse inserted 128 rows for the fresh run across the same six instruments; total alpaca-live rows after both validation runs = 260. Outstanding non-blocking discovery: Alpaca mass-status reconciliation warns on unsupported order side sell_short.
close_reason: Live market-data dual-write sink wired and validated through the Dockerized Alpaca path. Fresh image rebuilt with serialized cargo jobs, services recreated, 45s default compose live smoke wrote QuoteTick data to both ParquetDataCatalog and ClickHouse. ClickHouse received 128 fresh alpaca-live rows across six SPY option instruments; catalog wrote six matching per-instrument parquet files. Resource validation stayed within the 2GiB ClickHouse cap and libpostal did not restart.

title: Add self-hosted ClickHouse dev stack
description: Add a repo-level deploy/warehouse ClickHouse stack for local and self-hosted development, with persistent data/log volumes and operator smoke commands.
acceptance_criteria: A developer can start ClickHouse from deploy/warehouse and run a basic health or smoke command without using Alpaca deployment files.
close_reason: Added repo-level deploy/warehouse ClickHouse compose stack, README, and env example with local-only ports and smoke command; validated with docker compose -f deploy/warehouse/compose.yml config.

title: Add ClickHouse warehouse migrate command and quote tick schema
description: Add schema/sql/clickhouse migrations, warehouse.schema_migrations metadata, and a warehouse operator migrate command for market.quote_ticks.
acceptance_criteria: The warehouse operator applies versioned ClickHouse SQL, records checksums, and creates the canonical market.quote_ticks table.
close_reason: Added repo-level ClickHouse migration runner, nautilus warehouse migrate command, schema/sql/clickhouse/001_market_quote_ticks.sql, and warehouse.schema_migrations checksum metadata. Validated cargo check -p nautilus-persistence --features clickhouse, cargo check -p nautilus-cli, docker compose config, live ClickHouse migration apply/skip, table presence, and metadata row.

title: Add nautilus-persistence ClickHouse QuoteTick writer read smoke
description: Add optional ClickHouse support to nautilus-persistence with config, health, typed QuoteTick row mapping, and a small write/read smoke path.
acceptance_criteria: A Rust smoke writes a tiny QuoteTick batch to ClickHouse and reads counts back through the repo-level persistence boundary.
close_reason: Added repo-level ClickHouse QuoteTick smoke path; validated cargo fmt/check/build, warehouse health, live quote-smoke count=1, and direct ClickHouse source count.

title: Add transactional Alpaca state event and snapshot write
description: Add a repository method that inserts one strategy state event and updates the strategy_state snapshot idempotently in one transaction.
acceptance_criteria: A synthetic accepted or rejected state mutation can persist event and snapshot atomically and tolerate duplicate event IDs.
close_reason: Added persist_strategy_state_mutation repository contract with typed StrategyStateMutation/StrategyStateWriteResult. The transaction inserts strategy_state_events idempotently, locks/version-updates strategy_state only for new events, records writer/run/last_event metadata, and supports expected-version conflicts. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, and a disposable /tmp Rust harness calling the public method against local Alpaca Postgres: first synthetic entry_accepted write returned Applied version 1, replay returned DuplicateEvent version 1. Verified the DB row had one event and matching snapshot metadata, then deleted the generated smoke account rows.

title: Wire Alpaca strategy-state persistence sink into live readiness
description: Wire a Nautilus-native async state persistence sink into the live node and gate paper submit on storage readiness, lease, and sink health.
acceptance_criteria: The strategy keeps in-memory protection immediately, persists accepted/rejected state through the sink, and refuses live submit when persistence is unhealthy.
close_reason: Wired live option-chain node readiness to require Postgres storage only when live entry submit is requested; it now checks required migration version, acquires and heartbeats a runtime_lease, loads storage-backed state, and passes a StrategyStatePersistenceHandle into AlpacaOptionsEntryStrategy. The strategy refuses live entries when persistence is missing/unhealthy, keeps in-memory state updates immediate, and enqueues accepted plus terminal rejected/denied state mutations through the async sink. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, and a disposable /tmp harness against local Alpaca Postgres that acquired a lease, enqueued duplicate entry_accepted mutations through the public persistence handle, verified one event plus snapshot version 1 and lease row, then deleted the generated smoke rows.

title: Add Alpaca strategy state events metadata and runtime lease
description: Add strategy_state_events, snapshot version/writer metadata, and runtime_lease for the Alpaca operational store.
acceptance_criteria: The schema supports append-only strategy state mutations, optimistic snapshot metadata, and a DB-visible active writer guard.
close_reason: Added sqlx migration 202606230002 for strategy_state optimistic metadata, append-only strategy_state_events, and runtime_lease. Updated the Postgres plan to reflect migration-backed schema creation. Validated with forced Alpaca crate rebuild, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, cargo run -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bin alpaca-sync-strategy-state against local Alpaca Postgres, and direct psql checks for migration version, columns, tables, and indexes.

title: Enable sqlx migrations for Alpaca operational storage
description: Add sqlx migration support for the Alpaca operational Postgres store and make migration status part of startup/readiness.
acceptance_criteria: The Alpaca live path can apply and report sqlx migration state without a custom Postgres migration runner.
close_reason: Implemented shared nautilus-infrastructure Postgres SQLx migration/status helper, wired Alpaca StorageRepository and operator status to it, and validated with cargo check -p nautilus-infrastructure --features postgres plus cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins.

title: Move StorageRepository init schema DDL into migrations
description: Move the inline StorageRepository::init_schema DDL into versioned sqlx migration files while preserving existing Alpaca operational tables.
acceptance_criteria: Startup no longer grows an inline CREATE TABLE block; schema creation flows through versioned sqlx migrations.
close_reason: Moved Alpaca operational schema DDL into sqlx migration 202606230001_initial_operational_storage.sql; removed StorageRepository inline init_schema path. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, cargo run -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bin alpaca-sync-strategy-state against local Alpaca Postgres, and verified alpaca._sqlx_migrations version 202606230001 plus expected operational tables.

title: Implement repo-level ClickHouse market-data warehouse
description: Track the repo-level ClickHouse warehouse workstream: self-hosted stack, schema migration command, QuoteTick persistence proof, catalog backfill, read validation, and controlled cutover.
acceptance_criteria: ClickHouse is available as a generic Nautilus analytical backend without adapter-owned schema, hidden fallback reads, or Postgres market-data bloat.
close_reason: ClickHouse warehouse epic completed. The repo now owns a self-hosted ClickHouse dev stack, generic ClickHouse schema migrations under schema/sql/clickhouse, nautilus-persistence QuoteTick write/read smoke support, catalog-to-ClickHouse backfill proof, explicit quote validation/read-source cutover surface, and Postgres market-data cache cleanup. Validated live against local services with warehouse migrate/health/quote-smoke, docker compose warehouse smoke, direct ClickHouse smoke row check, Alpaca Postgres migration 202606230003 dropping backtest_market_cache, and Rust compile checks for nautilus-cli, nautilus-persistence clickhouse, and nautilus-alpaca live binaries.

title: Implement Alpaca operational Postgres durability
description: Track the clean Postgres durability refactor for the Alpaca live strategy path: sqlx migrations, append-only state events, runtime lease, transactional writes, and readiness gating.
acceptance_criteria: Live submit cannot be enabled until Postgres schema migration, state durability, runtime lease, and persistence health are proven through the standard operator path.
close_reason: Postgres durability epic completed. Storage schema now uses sqlx migrations; strategy_state has version/writer/run/event metadata; strategy_state_events and runtime_lease are in Postgres; persist_strategy_state_mutation writes event plus snapshot transactionally and idempotently; the option-chain live node gates live entry submit on storage readiness, migration version, runtime lease, and persistence handle health. Validated with cargo fmt/check and local Alpaca Postgres smoke harnesses for migration application, idempotent state mutation, runtime lease acquisition, async persistence enqueue, and smoke-row cleanup.

title: Split persistence catalog/query features from live ClickHouse dual-write
description: Slim the live Alpaca warehouse build by separating nautilus-persistence feature flags so live ClickHouse dual-write can compile catalog write and ClickHouse write support without pulling DataFusion SQL/query/backfill machinery unless operator/read commands need it.
acceptance_criteria: nautilus-persistence exposes narrower feature boundaries for live catalog writes, ClickHouse writes, catalog reads/backfill, and DataFusion-backed query/session code; nautilus-alpaca live warehouse builds do not compile DataFusion unless required; warehouse operator commands keep the heavier features where needed; targeted cargo checks prove both live and operator paths.

title: Speed up Alpaca Docker rollout builds
description: Reduce normal Alpaca Docker rollout compile time by adding BuildKit Cargo cache mounts, introducing a faster rollout Cargo profile, and splitting normal runtime binaries from optional operator/tool binaries.
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile uses persistent BuildKit caches for Cargo registry/git/target and copies built artifacts out of the cache mount; normal Docker builds default to a faster rollout profile while production release remains available by build arg; optional tools can be excluded from the default runtime image; compose config remains valid and a Docker build validates the default path.
close_reason: Implemented BuildKit Cargo registry/git/target caches, release-rollout default profile, and runtime/tools image split. Validation: docker compose config passed; git diff --check passed; default docker compose build alpaca-options completed and exported nautilus-alpaca:local; warmed rerun completed Rust build in 3m38s; slim image runs alpaca-options-engine --help, includes four core binaries, and excludes alpaca-compare-option-chain-scan.

title: Align ClickHouse warehouse database ownership
description: Live validation shows quote rows are stored in market.quote_ticks while the runtime config advertises CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE=warehouse. Clean this up so the repo-level warehouse has one explicit database ownership model: either the configured database owns quote tables or the config is renamed/removed if market is intentionally canonical. Also ensure operator validation queries are bounded enough to run under the self-hosted 2 GiB ClickHouse limit.
acceptance_criteria: Database naming is coherent between config, migrations, writer, reader, docs, and compose; no hard-coded market database remains unless it is the documented canonical database; live validation can verify recent quote rows without full-table aggregates exceeding the ClickHouse memory cap.
notes: Aligned ClickHouse ownership so market-data tables are canonical under market (default CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE/CLICKHOUSE_DB=market) and warehouse is reserved for operator metadata in warehouse.schema_migrations. Added explicit Rust constants for market quote table and warehouse metadata table, bootstrap migrations through default DB so fresh ClickHouse can create market/warehouse, and require bounded start_ns/end_ns for ClickHouse QuoteTick reads with event_date partition pruning. Validated cargo fmt -p nautilus-persistence -p nautilus-cli, cargo check -p nautilus-persistence --features clickhouse --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-cli, cargo check -p nautilus-data --features warehouse-clickhouse --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-live --features warehouse-clickhouse --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live,warehouse-clickhouse --bins, docker compose configs for warehouse/alpaca, live warehouse health/migrate/quote-smoke with CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE=market, unbounded validate-quotes fail-fast, and direct ClickHouse table ownership check for market.quote_ticks plus warehouse.schema_migrations.
close_reason: ClickHouse warehouse ownership is aligned: market owns quote tables, warehouse owns migration metadata, defaults/docs/compose match, and bounded validation was live-verified against the running self-hosted ClickHouse.

title: Fix same-day option expiry handling in live option-chain manager
description: During 2026-06-26 market-hours live validation, the host live option-chain node subscribed to SPY 2026-06-26 contracts but immediately logged that the series ALPACA:SPY:USD:2026-06-26T00:00:00Z was expired and dropped same-day quotes. This suggests option expiry is represented at midnight UTC for instruments that should remain tradable through the market session. Keep separate from the sell_short parser fix.
acceptance_criteria: A market-hours 0DTE option-chain subscription does not drop live quotes as expired before the exchange close/actual contract expiration; future-expiry behavior remains unchanged; targeted live or fixture-backed validation passes.
notes:
Live validation on 2026-06-26 avoided the 0DTE drop by overriding ALPACA_OPTION_CHAIN_EXPIRY=2026-06-30. With the future expiry, the live node subscribed to 6 SPY option instruments and flushed quote data successfully; the same-day expiry issue remains isolated to 0DTE handling.
Verified Alpaca /v2/options/contracts live response for SPY 2026-06-26 returns expiration_date as date-only (YYYY-MM-DD), not a timestamp. Updated adapter parsing to preserve RFC3339 timestamps if Alpaca ever returns them, otherwise normalize date-only option expirations to 16:15 America/New_York. Same-day live-node validation for SPY 2026-06-26 built series ALPACA:SPY:USD:2026-06-26T20:15:00Z, subscribed 354 cached instruments / 6 active instruments, emitted option_chain_opportunity_scan snapshots, and did not drop quotes as expired.
close_reason: Fixed Alpaca date-only option expiration normalization and validated same-day live option-chain quotes no longer drop as expired before close.

title: Support Alpaca sell_short side during mass-status reconciliation
description: Live Alpaca option-chain node reconciliation currently warns: failed to parse Alpaca payload: unsupported Alpaca order side: sell_short. This did not block market-data dual-write validation, but it weakens startup order/position reconciliation and should be fixed in the Alpaca adapter parser using Nautilus-native order-side semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A live or fixture-backed mass-status payload containing side=sell_short parses without warning and maps to the correct Nautilus side semantics; targeted Alpaca adapter check passes.
notes: Fixed order_side_from_alpaca to map Alpaca action-style order side values to Nautilus OrderSide: buy_to_cover/buy_to_open/buy_to_close => Buy, sell_short/sell_to_open/sell_to_close => Sell. Host live-node validation during market hours reached LiveNode startup reconciliation and succeeded: received 739 orders, 428 fills, 8 positions; reconciliation succeeded with no unsupported sell_short warning. Dual-write was disabled for that host parser validation to avoid adding storage rows.
close_reason: Alpaca order-side parser now accepts sell_short and related action-style side values. Validated with cargo fmt, cargo test -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --lib, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live,warehouse-clickhouse --bins, and a live host option-chain node startup reconciliation with no sell_short parse warning.

title: Build catalog to ClickHouse backfill proof
description: Build the first catalog-backed warehouse backfill operation for QuoteTick data with row counts and run audit output.
acceptance_criteria: A sampled catalog date and instrument range loads into ClickHouse and validates counts through the warehouse operator.
close_reason: Added warehouse backfill-quotes operator path backed by ParquetDataCatalog and ClickHouse QuoteTick writer; validated cargo fmt/check/build, live backfill from 64-bit catalog sample with catalog_rows=9500 written_rows=9500 warehouse_rows=9500, and direct ClickHouse count for ingest run.

title: Slim Postgres market-data cache after warehouse proof
description: Retire or narrow Postgres market-data-shaped cache usage after catalog and ClickHouse cover those datasets.
acceptance_criteria: Postgres keeps operational state, evidence, outcomes, leases, and small manifests only; bulk market data and scanner feature time series move to catalog or ClickHouse.
close_reason: Retired the Postgres backtest_market_cache path after ClickHouse proof. Removed Alpaca options-backtest Postgres market-cache reads/writes and the storage market_cache module/export, added forward sqlx migration 202606230003_drop_backtest_market_cache.sql, and updated active docs/checklists to keep market-data-shaped caches in catalog/ClickHouse rather than Postgres. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, cargo check -p nautilus-cli, cargo check -p nautilus-persistence --features clickhouse, local Alpaca Postgres migration application via alpaca-sync-strategy-state proving backtest_market_cache is absent and migration 202606230003 is recorded, ClickHouse warehouse migrate/health/quote-smoke via nautilus CLI, docker compose warehouse smoke, and direct ClickHouse row check for source live-validation.

title: Add warehouse read validation and cutover flag
description: Add explicit catalog versus ClickHouse validation for selected dataset ranges and a simple read-source flag for controlled cutover.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can validate a supported range, switch reads to clickhouse mode, and roll back to catalog mode by configuration.
close_reason: Added repo-level QuoteTick validate-quotes operator command, market-data read-source flag parsing, and selected-source QuoteTick read helper. Validated cargo fmt/check/build plus live catalog-vs-ClickHouse validation for 9500 rows with NAUTILUS_MARKET_DATA_READ_SOURCE=clickhouse and rollback to catalog.
